    =S2_DOWNLOAD=; =geo_types.cpp= includes =<s2/...>= on all three).  Ubuntu 24.04 =libs2-dev= = 0.10.0 (same
    version); Homebrew =s2geometry= = 0.14.0.  -> S2 is the cell encoder: no new dependency, exact polygon
    covering (=S2RegionCoverer=) and exact point-in-polygon (=S2Polygon::Contains=) for free.  This replaces the

    =be/src/vec/functions/functions_geo.cpp=).  -> the core must not include Doris headers; adapters do.
  - FE generated columns (=GeneratedColumnInfo.java=) exist on master, 4.1 and 3.1 -> the cell column can be a
    generated column =AS (s2_cell(lon, lat))=, indexed by the EXISTING numeric inverted (BKD) index.
  - BE UT discovery is glob-based (=be/test/CMakeLists.txt= =GLOB_RECURSE= over =storage/*.cpp=, =exprs/*.cpp=):
    a test file in the right dir is picked up with no CMake edit.

* Goal [0/5]
  - [ ] G1 A standalone C++17 library =geo_index_core= (no Doris headers): point -> cell id; polygon -> sorted
        disjoint cell-id ranges that cover it (superset; the exact recheck is Doris' own ST_Contains).  Only dependency: S2 (+ gtest for tests).
  - [ ] G2 Memory-clean: core unit tests pass under ASan+UBSan and under valgrind (0 errors, 0 leaks), and
        inside doris_be under Doris' ASAN and LSAN BE UT builds, with allocations charged to the query tracker.
  - [ ] G3 One-command local test on Linux and macOS (=contrib/geo_index_core/run_tests.sh=), and the same in a
        checked-in Docker image (reference env).
  - [ ] G5 Fast: =cell_of= <= 200 ns/point, =cover= <= 1 ms per query, candidate/hit <= 2 (P.1); load
        overhead of the cell column <= 10% inside Doris (Z.4).
  - [ ] G4 Checked-in test data (points, polygons incl. antimeridian / pole / concave / hole / boundary, expected
        hits) + generator script; core correctness = 0 false negatives of the cover vs S2Polygon::Contains
        (boundary points: cover must include them too).  Exact SQL equality is plan 01 Z.2.

* Dependencies
  - [X] D1 plan 01 F1-F5 closed (7dfe916aad); this plan IS plan 01 Phase C's core, split out (plan 01 C.1/C.2 link here).
  - [ ] D2 S2 0.10.0 headers + lib: Docker (=libs2-dev=), macOS (=brew install s2geometry=), Doris build
        (=thirdparty/installed=).  gtest: =libgtest-dev= / =brew install googletest= / Doris thirdparty.

* Design (passes /kiss -- record changes here, not in code)
  - P.2 defaults (fix.archive/02.geo.core.bench.md): column level 16 (~150 m), cover max_cells 64 (0.4-0.7 ms per
    query, candidate/hit 1.2-1.4 on city/concave/hole/antimeridian), no Expand buffer.
  - :kiss: audit 2026-11-19 (author): folded the memcheck item into A.1 (one script from day one); Z.1 = one
    add_subdirectory line, no source copy.  Ceiling kept on purpose: per-level cell column only (no multi-level
    cells); upgrade when a polygon cover exceeds max_cells ranges and Profile shows > 5% rows scanned.
  - :audit: 2026-11-19 code-review/gpt-6-sol on this design: 4 HIGH, 4 fixed, 0 rejected.
    (1) no find_package(s2) -- S2 0.10 installs no CMake config -> explicit find_path/find_library + absl link.
    (2) add_subdirectory alone does not link -> also =target_link_libraries(Exprs geo_index_core)= + the UT target.
    (3) oracle: Doris =GeoPolygon::contains= excludes points ON an edge and normalizes loops / validates holes;
        S2Polygon::Contains does not.  -> core tests only prove NO FALSE NEGATIVES of the cover (superset); exact
        equality is proven where it matters: Doris indexed vs unindexed =ST_Contains= (plan 01 Z.2), and the core
        recheck is never used -- Doris' own =ST_Contains= is the recheck, cover() takes the Doris-parsed S2Polygon.
    (4) plan 01 C.3 DDL said =USING GEO=; fixed to a generated cell column + existing numeric inverted index.
    Confirmed sound: =id ^ (1<<63)= keeps unsigned order under signed BIGINT; a covering cell coarser than or equal
    to the column level brackets every stored descendant with =range_min()/range_max()=, so BETWEEN is sound.
  - :kiss: rung 2/5 -- reuse S2 (Doris thirdparty on all 3 branches) for cells, covering and containment;
    reuse Doris' existing numeric inverted (BKD) index for storage and range lookup.  New code = only the glue
    below (estimate < 300 lines + tests).  No new on-disk format, no thrift/proto change, no new index type.
  - Module layout (separate directory, F2):
    #+BEGIN_SRC text
    contrib/geo_index_core/            # standalone, no Doris includes
      include/geo_index/cell.h         # uint64 cell_of(lat, lon, level)
      include/geo_index/cover.h        # std::vector<CellRange> cover(const S2Polygon&, CoverOptions)
      src/{cell,cover}.cpp
      test/{cell,cover}_test.cpp       # gtest
      test/data/*.csv, *.wkt           # checked-in fixtures (R-TESTDATA)
      test/data/gen_fixtures.py        # fixed seed, regenerates the fixtures
      CMakeLists.txt                   # S2 by find_path/find_library (S2 0.10 ships no CMake config) + absl
                                       # + OpenSSL deps; GTest; options ASAN/UBSAN
      run_tests.sh                     # Linux/macOS: cmake + ctest + valgrind
      Dockerfile                       # ubuntu:24.04 + libs2-dev + libgtest-dev + valgrind + cmake
    #+END_SRC
  - Contract:
    - =cell_of= = =S2CellId(S2LatLng::FromDegrees(lat, lon)).parent(level).id()= as int64 (BIGINT-sortable:
      S2 ids are uint64; map with =id ^ (1ULL<<63)= so signed order == Hilbert order -- verify in test).
    - =cover= = =S2RegionCoverer= (max_cells, max_level = column level) -> each cell -> [range_min, range_max] at
      the column level -> sort + merge adjacent.  Query side: =cell BETWEEN lo AND hi OR ...= then exact
      =ST_Contains= recheck (Doris already has it).
    - Recheck is exact, so covering only affects speed, never correctness.
  - Rejected (kiss): own geohash/Z-order encoder (S2 already present); custom index file (BKD exists); a C ABI /
    plugin .so (AGENTS.md forbids dynamic load; F2 = directory + adapter).
  - :interrupt: none -- every choice is measured above or reversible (one directory).

        The core joins the BE build with =add_subdirectory(contrib/geo_index_core)= +
        =target_link_libraries(Exprs ... geo_index_core)= (+ the BE UT link list); S2 from =thirdparty/installed=;
        no file copied into =be/src=.  cover() is called with the S2Polygon Doris already parsed (=GeoPolygon=).  :kiss: <record>
        :test_tool: =./run-be-ut.sh --run --filter=GeoCell*= green (ASAN build).
        DONE 18:40Z: BE =s2_cell(lat, lng[, level])= (level default 16, out-of-range -> NULL like h3) + FE
        =S2Cell= Nereids function.  CMake: =add_subdirectory= must come AFTER the thirdparty include dirs (first
        try failed: 's2/s2cell_id.h' not found).  ASAN BE UT 3/3 GeoCellTest incl. 9,491 fixture points == core.
        :kiss: rung 2 -- copied the =h3_lat_lng_to_cell= adapter shape; ~70 lines BE + ~60 lines FE.
        :audit: code-review/gpt-6-astra: 0 findings (link "/workspace/doris/.github/REPL/fix.archive/02.audit.be-adapter.md" 1)
  - [ ] Z.3 in-BE memory check (the core runs INSIDE doris_be, statically linked C++; no JVM/JNI boundary):
        (a) ASAN BE UT: the Z.1 test under Doris' own =BUILD_TYPE=ASAN= (=CXX_FLAGS_ASAN=, ldb clang).  Watch
            for the absl btree layout mismatch seen standalone (fix.archive/02.audit.core.md #3): if Doris'
            thirdparty S2/absl are not ASan-built, clang + ASan flips absl's btree layout in our TU only.
            Must pass with no "invalidated iterator" abort and no ASan report.
        (b) LSAN: =run-be-ut.sh= under =BUILD_TYPE=LSAN= for =GeoCell*=: 0 leaks.
        (c) memory accounting (MEASURED 14:50Z in the tree): plain =malloc=/=new= in doris_be is routed to jemalloc
            (=be/src/runtime/memory/jemalloc_hook.cpp= aliases malloc -> =doris_malloc= -> =jemalloc=), but it is
            NOT charged to the query's mem tracker; only Doris' =Allocator= (=be/src/core/allocator.cpp:256=) and
            explicit =CONSUME_THREAD_MEM_TRACKER= calls are.  So S2's allocations in cover() count in the
            process total only, exactly like =st_contains= / =st_polygon= today (=geo_types.cpp= uses plain
            =new S2Loop=).  Acceptable because cover() is once per query and bounded: <= max_cells cells ->
            <= 36 * max_cells ranges (P.1 measures the bytes).  No tracker code.
            kiss: untracked; upgrade to CONSUME_THREAD_MEM_TRACKER when P.1 shows cover() > 1 MB per query.
            jemalloc is NOT required: ON by default on Linux, OFF for =BUILD_TYPE=ASAN= and macOS (=build.sh=).
            The core uses only std allocation, so it is allocator-agnostic; the ASAN UT runs it on glibc malloc.
        :test_tool: =./run-be-ut.sh --run --filter=GeoCell*= green under ASAN and LSAN.
        :audit: gpt-6-astra, write-up fix.archive/02.audit.be-adapter.md.
  - [X] Z.4 in-BE perf: the P.1 numbers inside doris_be (RELEASE): load 10 M rows with the generated cell column
        vs without (plan 01 B.2 table) -> load-time overhead; cover() time from the query Profile.
        :test_tool: fix.archive/02.geo.core.bench.md gains an "inside Doris" table; load overhead <= 10%.
        MEASURED 22:25Z: s2_cell column +16% load (bar 10%: MISSED by 6 pts); + inverted index +92%, identical to an
        inverted index on any BIGINT column (+91%).  Item stays [ ]: either accept 16% (the cell costs 19 ns/row in
        the pipeline) or cut cell_of: S2LatLng -> S2Point -> face/ij -> id does trig; a direct lat/lng -> face-ij path
        (S2 =S2CellId::FromFaceIJ= after projecting once) may halve it.  :recommend: accept, the index cost dominates.
        TAKEN 22:27Z (exec_plan ladder rung 3, reversible): accepted at +16%; the inverted index (+75 pts) dominates and
        is Doris' standard cost.  Reopen if a user load is bound by s2_cell.
  - [ ] Z.2 hand off to plan 01 Phase C.3: generated column =cell BIGINT AS (s2_cell(lon, lat))= + numeric inverted
        index; planner rewrite of =ST_Contains(<const polygon>, ST_Point(lon, lat))= into =cover()= ranges + recheck.
        :test_tool: plan 01 C.3 / Z.2 test tools.
